article.title: Our Lefts: Lessons from the Socialist and Communist Parties
article.author: Van Gosse
article.content: It certainly is the worst of times–far too many crises and crimes to list here, horrifically dangerous, no center holds, and so on. And yet, not at all paradoxically, it is the best of times in a very long time for anyone who believes in an American Left, dispensing with the ignorant shibboleth that there has never been one.
